messages.subject: Jake Essex for The Lockhouse?
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm Natalie. I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Jake would be a great fit for The Lockhouse in Paddington, and he'd love to come and perform for you.

He's performed in over 500 venues over the past 10 years and built a good reputation for singing the classics without the corny impersonation. He's branching out to new venues now.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist from Essex. 50s, 60s and into the 70s: Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis & more. He is the act. No tribute, no jumpsuit, no corny impersonations. Own PA, fully self-contained, no deposit.

Have a look: www.jakeessex.co.uk

Saturday nights this year and into 2027. If a date works, just reply here and I'll lock it in.

Natalie

messages.subject: Re: Re: Jake Essex for Pied Bull?
messages.body:
Hi Lucy,

Thanks for getting back to me. For two hours (two 1 hour sets), Jake is £300 cash for a single night, or £250 a night if you book four dates. Own PA, no deposit.

So you have everything in one place, here are both rate cards and his free Saturdays.

Prices (cash on the night, own PA, no deposit):
Two 1 hour sets: £300 for a single night, or £250 a night if you book four dates.
Three sets: £350 for a single night, or £300 a night if you book four dates.

Free Saturdays: 7 November 2026, 2 January 2027, 6 March 2027, 27 March 2027, 5 June 2027, 11 September 2027, 16 October 2027, 6 November 2027, 20 November 2027, 11 December 2027.

They are going quickly with block bookings, so just reply with a date that works and I will lock it in.

Natalie
